title: The Deepest Point in the Ocean Presses Down With 8 Tons Per Square Inch

scenes.text: The deepest spot in the ocean squeezes harder than anything you have felt.
That's Challenger Deep, almost seven miles down.
The pressure there is about 1,000 times what you feel at sea level.
Eight tons on every square inch.
That's more than 16,000 pounds, on a space about the size of a postage stamp.
And in 2019 a crewed submarine still went all the way down.
